title: Word Builder: Letter Match
description: Match letters to build words and boost your vocabulary! Swap adjacent letter tiles to line up vowels and consonants in colorful combinations. Learn spelling patterns, expand your vocabulary, and develop language skills through fun and engaging puzzle gameplay.
learning_objectives: Improve vocabulary by recognizing letter patterns and combinations
Practice spelling through strategic letter matching
Develop language skills by understanding vowel and consonant relationships
Build pattern recognition skills through tile-matching gameplay
Enhance reading readiness through letter familiarity
how_to_play: Swap two adjacent letter tiles to create a match of 3 or more identical letters in a row or column.
Matched letters clear from the board and earn you word points.
Cleared tiles cascade down and new letters fill in from the top — look for chain combos!
Longer matches (4 or 5 in a row) earn bonus points and create bigger word chains.
You have 30 moves to reach the target score of 400 word points.
Mix vowels and consonants strategically to maximize your matches!

storybook_pages.title: The Letter Library
storybook_pages.text: Welcome to the magical Letter Library, where vowels and consonants come alive! The bookshelves are jumbled and letters are scattered everywhere. Your mission: match letters by swapping them into rows and columns. Every match brings order to the chaos and earns you word points!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: magical library with floating letter tiles in warm and cool colors, bookshelves in the background, a young reader with a wand sorting letters on a game grid, sparkles and books, whimsical cartoon style

storybook_pages.title: Vowels and Consonants
storybook_pages.text: Vowels (A, E, I/O/U) glow in warm colors — they're the heart of every word. Consonant groups (B/C/D, F/G/H, and more) shine in cool colors — they give words their shape. Match three or more of the same type and watch them sparkle away!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: colorful letter characters divided into two teams: warm-colored vowels (A, E, I/O/U) on one side and cool-colored consonants on the other, both on a puzzle grid, friendly educational cartoon style

storybook_pages.title: Word Champion
storybook_pages.text: You've matched your way to the top! Every letter cleared has taught you something about how words are built — from vowel patterns to consonant clusters. You're now a Word Champion with sharper spelling and vocabulary skills!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: triumphant scene with completed puzzle board, a golden trophy shaped like the letter A, scattered letter confetti, happy kid wearing a champion crown, bookshelves filled with glowing books, celebratory cartoon style
